name: Plan
summary: Makes a plan an action built from references to other actions, so that a plan can be nested, replaced and depended upon without a structure of its own.

roles.name: Plan
roles.summary: A composite action: it holds references to the proposed actions it is made of, and it is itself an action, so a plan is a step of a larger plan without anything special being said.

roles.name: ActionReference
roles.summary: One proposed action's place in one plan. It exists because the same action can appear in two plans and must not be confused between them; the pair of plan and action is unique.

roles.name: PlanDependency
roles.summary: That one reference must follow another. Both ends belong to the same plan, and the graph they form is acyclic — a plan whose steps depend on each other in a circle cannot be scheduled, and that is a fact about the model rather than about a scheduler.

roles.name: Replaces
roles.summary: The plan this one supersedes. Keeping the replaced plan rather than editing it is what lets a change of plan be seen as such, and what a variance against the original is measured from.

roles.name: Components
roles.summary: The references this plan is made of. Reached through references rather than directly, which is what keeps one proposed action shared between plans instead of copied into each.
